  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · MATRICES AND DETERMINANTS
    - heading "Minors and Cofactors" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Explore minors and cofactors with an interactive 3×3 matrix. Click any entry to see the row and column removed, the minor, the sign (−1)ⁱ⁺ʲ, and the cofactor.
    - link "School lessons":
      - /url: /lessons/school
      - img
      - text: School lessons
    - article:
      - heading "1 Select an entry" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Click any entry (aᵢⱼ) in matrix A.
      - text: j=1 j=2 j=3 i=1 i=2 i=3
      - button "entry row 1 column 1 value 1": "1"
      - button "entry row 1 column 2 value 2": "2"
      - button "entry row 1 column 3 value 3": "3"
      - button "entry row 2 column 1 value 0": "0"
      - button "entry row 2 column 2 value 4": "4"
      - button "entry row 2 column 3 value 5": "5"
      - button "entry row 3 column 1 value 1": "1"
      - button "entry row 3 column 2 value 0": "0"
      - button "entry row 3 column 3 value 6": "6"
      - strong:
        - text: "Selected entry: a"
        - subscript: "23"
        - text: = 5 (i=2, j=3)
    - article:
      - heading "2 Row 2 and Column 3 are crossed out" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Remove row i=2 and column j=3.
      - text: j=1 j=2 j=3 i=1 i=2 i=3 1 2 3 0 4 5 1 0 6
    - article:
      - heading "3 Minor (delete row 2 and column 3)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The remaining submatrix is the minor matrix.
      - text: M
      - subscript: "23"
      - text: = 1 2 1 0
      - emphasis: (2×2)
    - article:
      - heading "4 Compute the minor M23" [level=3]:
        - text: 4 Compute the minor M
        - subscript: "23"
      - paragraph: Determinant of the 2×2 submatrix.
      - text: M
      - subscript: "23"
      - text: = (1·0) − (2·1) = -2
      - strong:
        - text: M
        - subscript: "23"
        - text: = -2
    - article:
      - heading "5 Sign from checkerboard" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Sign = (−1)ⁱ⁺ʲ
      - text: + − + − + − + − +
      - paragraph:
        - text: "For (i,j)=(2,3): (−1)"
        - superscript: 2+3
        - text: = -1
      - strong: Sign = -1
    - article:
      - heading "6 Cofactor C23" [level=3]:
        - text: 6 Cofactor C
        - subscript: "23"
      - paragraph: Multiply the minor by the sign.
      - text: C
      - subscript: "23"
      - text: = (-1) · (-2) = 2
      - strong:
        - text: C
        - subscript: "23"
        - text: = 2
    - complementary:
      - img
      - text: "Minor and cofactor differ by sign only:"
      - paragraph: Cᵢⱼ=(−1)ⁱ⁺ʲMᵢⱼ. Here, M=-2 and C=2.
    - article:
      - heading "7 Determinant expansion preview (along row 2)" [level=3]
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Using cofactors from row 2: det(A) = Σ a"
        - subscript: 2j
        - text: C
        - subscript: 2j

          - row "Product 0·-12=0 4·3=12 5·2=10":

            - cell "5·2=10"
      - strong: det(A) = 0 + 12 + 10 = 22
